era_note: This is the Visual Studio 2005 edition of the wizard, captured in January 2006. It is not the Visual Studio .NET 2002 release the narration is describing. Microsoft's own article says the 2005 upgrade engine is "much improved over the previous version", so a 2002 run would likely have shown different, probably more, issues. That is not verified here.
